title: Lyrran's BattleCraft
description: Buckle up for an adventure! There will be magic, monsters, cute critters, dark dungeons, vampires, werewolves and--if you're on the wrong side of things--hunters. Thanks to Project MMO, you will have to fight to be able to use the tools you require ahead!
body:
A side project from Lyrran, without Kiki this time but she will enjoy it all the same. I wanted to build something that calls to the RPG players, the fantasy folks and bring a real challenge. We hope you enjoy it!

Lyrran and Kiki

What are you still looking at this for? You want more? Why aren't you playing it already?! Seriously, that's the best way to find out about the monsters and stuff. I mean there is nothing better than the thrill of making your own tools--using Tinker's Construct--, casting spells--using Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks--, and fighting dragons, vampires, werewolves, hunters--you crazy vampires--, medusa, sea serpents, sirens--oh, how I hate them--, along with the rest of what Minecraft already has. Oh! When I'm feeling lazy--which isn't often--why are you laughing? I'm serious. When I'm feeling lazy, I just take over one of Valhesia's Structures instead of building my own. See, now you got me ranting! Just--just go adventuring already!

June 12, 2026, Currently working on a better leveling mod and trying to make it compatible with Iron's and Tinker's, at the very least.
